This week, K-pop stars' official appearances in Seoul centered on Gangnam and Seongsu.

Tuesday's Barrie event drew IVE's Jang Wonyoung (@for_everyoung10) and NCT DREAM's Jaemin, and Wednesday's preview of the Bulgari exhibition at SONGEUN welcomed Bulgari ambassador Jang Wonyoung and MONSTA X's Shownu. On Thursday, Yeonjun of TOMORROW X TOGETHER (@txt_bighit) appeared at a Longines event in Sinsa-dong, and KiiiKiii stopped by the Rockfish Weatherwear store in Seongsu-dong.

The events lasted a day, but there are still places to visit. The SONGEUN exhibition runs until mid-November, and the Stray Kids (@realstraykids) pop-up is open through next Sunday.

이름은 'ACG 북촌 마루'인데요, 한옥 구조를 살린 채 리스닝 트레일·커뮤니티 서클·익스페디션 룸·중정·한옥 랩, 다섯 구역으로 나눴습니다. 옷을 파는 매장이면서 트레일 러너와 하이커가 모이는 베이스캠프 역할을 합니다.

The musical 'Hamilton' makes its Korea debut in Busan this December.

It is the show's first visit to Korea since it opened on Broadway in 2015. After a month at Dream Theatre in Busan, it moves to the Grand Theater of Sejong Center for the Performing Arts in Seoul in January. The title role goes to Jason Arrow, who played Hamilton in the Australian premiere and on the first international tour.

One thing changed ahead of ticket sales. The producer announced that because of strong language in some scenes, the minimum age has been raised from elementary school students to middle school students.

Seoul: Jan 21 (Thu) – Mar 20, 2027 (Sat) · Sejong Center for the Performing Arts, Grand Theater

키키(@kiiikiii.official) 키야가 식당에 혼자 남았습니다.

10월 30일 키키 공식 유튜브에 올라온 〈키키팡팡〉 EP.27은 연애 리얼리티를 패러디한 '모태소울로지옥'의 두 번째 편이자 최종 선택이 담긴 편인데요, 멤버 다섯이 저마다 캐릭터를 맡아 소울메이트를 고르는 콩트입니다. 저녁 자리에서 두 사람이 산책을 나가자, 테이블에 남은 키야가 짧게 한마디를 남깁니다. "인생이 쓰다."

키야는 이 편에서 하음에게 마음을 전했지만, 최종 선택에서 이솔과 수이, 지유와 하음이 짝이 되면서 끝내 혼자 남았습니다.

shorts.caption:
KiiiKiii (@kiiikiii.official) member KYA is left alone at a restaurant table.

EP.27 of 'KiiiKiii PangPang', posted on KiiiKiii's official YouTube channel on Oct 30, is the second installment of 'Motae Soul-ro Jiok' (Born-Solo Soul Hell), a parody of dating reality shows, and the one with the final choice. In the sketch, each of the five members plays a character and picks a soulmate. Over dinner, two of them head out for a walk, and KYA, left at the table, says just one line: "Life is bitter."

KYA confessed her feelings to HAUM in this episode, but in the final choice LEESOL paired with SUI and JIYU with HAUM, leaving her on her own.
